levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: «حدثنا أبي» opens with three co-transmitters (the father is a bare relation, rule 7); the attached و of «وأحمد» is left out.
«عن أبيه بشير الدهان»: one link, the name alone (rule 7).
The Imam after «عن» stays a narrator (rule in the Imami section); «قال رسول الله» is the saying. The blessing «رضي الله عنهم» is left out.
